summary: Full regression test after the Expo SDK 58 upgrade (expo 58.0.20, RN 0.88, React 19.3, expo-router 58.0.27, reanimated 4.7.1, gesture-handler 3.3.0, @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons 14.0.0), backend and frontend, at a 390x844 viewport. Backend: test_factor_f.py, test_case_sheet.py and test_no_auth_flow.py all pass, 35/35. The rounding fix works: obesidad_moderada + diabetes_vascular gives 1.093. Cases CRUD, status, calculations, notes, the /report PDF and stats are all fine. Frontend: the welcome carousel (Siguiente x3, Comenzar) and Saltar both reach the Casos tab. All 5 bottom tabs render with Ionicons glyphs (the Ionicons font is loaded; 34 glyph elements found, none blank). Note: the Estadísticas tab is labeled 'Historial'. /case/new: factor-f-value goes —, then 0.950, then 1.093. Creating a case runs POST /cases then PUT /sheet, then navigates to the case detail with 5 tabs (Cálculos/Notas/Bitácora/Docs/Reporte). Volume calculator: casetype-sheet is preselected with F 1.093, weight 80 is prefilled, the result is 14.59 L x1.093, and saving to the case works. Wizard: LBM 60.5 kg, then ratio, then wiz-casetype-sheet with F 1.093, volume computed and saved (LBM and injection calculations). Adding a note, adding a logbook entry, the attachment sheet (camera/gallery/PDF plus 3 labels) and the report preview viewer (PDF rendered with the Factor F rows) all work. Hoja del caso (/case/sheet) shows the saved condition with F 1.093 and peso 80. Edit case (new?id=) loads the saved data. Library: Referencia articles, Catálogo folders (4), Mis documentos folders (2), and opening/going back from a folder all work. No page errors or console errors/warnings. `expo install --check`: dependencies up to date. tsc --noEmit is clean. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) and no react-native SafeAreaView imports.

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() after saving does nothing when the wizard is opened by direct deep link (no history). The user stays on the wizard after the 'guardado' toast. Consider falling back to router.replace(`/case/${caseId}`) when !router.canGoBack(). Does not happen with in-app navigation.

issues: The quick guide step 1 still says 'Inicia sesión con tu correo o con Google', and the FAQ says 'Cada profesional accede únicamente a sus propios casos... ligado a tu cuenta'. The app is no-auth, so this copy is stale (pre-existing, not an SDK regression).

action_items: Optional: in wizard.tsx (and similar modals), fall back to router.replace to the case when router.canGoBack() is false after saving.
Optional: update the Ayuda copy to remove the login/account references (no-auth app).
Housekeeping (carried over): delete the obsolete auth-based tests test_pdf_publish.py and test_preservia_api.py.
critical_code_review_comments: use-icon-fonts.ts hard-codes IONICONS_VERSION='14.0.0'. It must be kept in sync with package.json manually; consider reading it from require('@react-native-vector-icons/ionicons/package.json').version.
The BODY_CONDITIONS table is still duplicated in the frontend (factorF.ts) and the backend (server.py). The rounding epsilon logic now matches on both sides.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass (1 low-priority deep-link back nav note)
